answer: Because the age is read from the nectar checkpoint rather than self-declared, the summit audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm thus means funding each duplicate self through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. An identity must be at least 8 epochs old on the whisper ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. That is 16 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
